note: Botswana, read on the Government of Botswana's own service pages (gov.bw, Residency and Work: Work Permit Application, Residence Permit Application and Permanent Residence Application) on 2026-10-30; fees are in pula. A work permit gives a non-citizen permission to work in Botswana for reward or to invest for profit: the form is submitted with the contract, the job advert, the offer letter and the understudies' CVs to the nearest Labour Office, and the service takes fourteen working days; renewal is asked six months before the permit expires, with the renewed contract and copies of both work and residence permits (renewable). Its fee isn't on the page, nor its term, nor whether the work is bound to the employer, nor whether the applicant may be abroad. Every non-citizen staying beyond the visit also needs a residence permit from an Immigration office (thirty working days; the page's fees are for dependants and students, P1,500), not written apart since it isn't tied to a purpose. Permanent residence is for those who have resided lawfully and continuously in Botswana at least five years ('more than 5 years' in its notes; 5 kept as the work permit's years to it), of good character, with significant contributions and means; employees apply at any Immigration and Citizenship office with their work and residence permits and the employer's confirmation (in country), P3,000. The page gives both '56 working days' and 'six months' for it, so no time is kept; what work it allows isn't stated. Naturalisation isn't read here.

sources.title: Government of Botswana, Work Permit Application
sources.said: This service gives a non-citizen permission to work in Botswana for a reward or to invest in Botswana for profit. ... Download, complete the Work permit application form and submit with supporting documents to the nearest Labour Office ... Fourteen (14) working days ... In case of renewal of work permit for employee and investor ... Application for Renewal is to be submitted six (6) months before expiry of work permit

sources.title: Government of Botswana, Residence Permit Application
sources.said: All non-citizens who wish to stay in Botswana should apply for a residence permit to allow them to live in the country. ... Thirty (30) working days to complete.

sources.title: Government of Botswana, Permanent Residence Application
sources.said: Resided lawfully in Botswana continuously for at least 5 years ... Go to any Immigration and Citizenship Office ... EMPLOYEES ... Confirmation of employment by the employer/reference letter. ... P3000.00 ... NB: The applicant must have stayed in the country for more than 5 years. ... This service takes 56 working days. ... This service takes six months.
